description: pi-mono distinguishes user messages from assistant messages using a subtle background color on user turns (backgroundSecondary from the theme). Add this to OctoPi.TUI.Components.UserMessage: wrap each rendered line with the theme's backgroundSecondary ANSI escape. This provides visual turn separation without needing a glyph prefix. The background should extend to the full terminal width (pad with spaces to width before applying background color).
title: User message background styling
